rows.name:
A team investigating ancient ruins have found some[XENO:n ]
ancient writing. However, it will take time to decipher.[XENO:n ]
Collect materials to build a deciphering machine.

Collect 6 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Sturdy Armour[/System:Color] from[XENO:n ]
Flavel Andos at Eryth Sea.
Return to Russ.

The deciphering machine is ready. Now they[XENO:n ]
should be able to decipher the writing with ease.

The accuracy of the deciphering machine is pretty low.[XENO:n ]
It's not going to be possible to read the writing at this[XENO:n ]
rate. Collect some materials to make improvements.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Green Diodes[/System:Color] in the High Entia Tomb.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Astas Remote Units[/System:Color] from Hover Astas[XENO:n ]
in the High Entia Tomb.
Return to Natori.

The machine has been improved and is working.[XENO:n ]
The writing is about the High Entia War God.

Talia has gone to the Satorl ruins alone. She was[XENO:n ]
warned that it was too dangerous but she wouldn't[XENO:n ]
listen. You must go after her!

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Dogmatic Gogol[/System:Color] at the Place of[XENO:n ]
Judgement in Satorl Marsh.
Talk to Talia.

You saved Talia's life. It looks like she and her[XENO:n ]
team are looking for the true War God statue.

Melissa's son Mirallis went to train at Eryth Sea.[XENO:n ]
It's very dangerous there, so she wants you to find him[XENO:n ]
and bring him back.
Find Mirallis at Eryth Sea.
Return to Melissa.

Mirallis promised not to do anything else foolish[XENO:n ]
so his mother won't have to worry any more.

Coles has agreed to become Mirallis's instructor.[XENO:n ]
However, he doesn't have the teaching materials he[XENO:n ]
needs. Why don't you ask Coles what he is missing?
Talk to Coles.

Collect 3 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Murky Eluca Water[/System:Color] from Perna[XENO:n ]
Elucas at Eryth Sea.
Talk to Coles.
Return to Mirallis.

Now that Coles has all the materials he needs,[XENO:n ]
he should be able to start training Mirallis.

Mirallis says that there has been an unusual[XENO:n ]
increase in monster numbers at Eryth Sea.[XENO:n ]
Help the Imperial Guards protect Achamoth.
Talk to Lecrough.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Buono Nebulae[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.
Return to Lecrough.
Return to Mirallis.

The imperial city's safety has been ensured.[XENO:n ]
Lecrough praised Mirallis for his actions.

In addition to Mirallis's request, Lecrough has asked[XENO:n ]
you to defeat some extra monsters. Take care of them[XENO:n ]
before reporting in to Lecrough.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Bono Nebulae[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

Because of your help, none of the Imperial [XENO:n ]
Guards were seriously injured.

Seagal likes two girls called Rosa and Riko. He[XENO:n ]
wants you to find out how they feel about him.
Talk to Riko.
Talk to Rosa.
Return to Seagal.

You found out how they feel about him. They[XENO:n ]
both seem to not dislike him.

Seagal still likes both girls but he's not sure which[XENO:n ]
one he likes best. Ask both of the girls what their[XENO:n ]
favourite memory of him is.
Talk to Rosa or Riko.
Talk to Rosa.
Talk to Riko.
Return to Seagal.

Having heard what Riko had to say, Seagal[XENO:n ]
has decided to tell Riko he likes her.

Having heard what Rosa had to say, Seagal[XENO:n ]
has decided to tell Rosa he likes her.

Finally Seagal has decided to tell Riko he likes her.[XENO:n ]
But he doesn't want to approach her while Rosa is[XENO:n ]
near. Deliver a letter to Riko for him.
Talk to Riko.
Return to Seagal.

Riko read the letter from Seagal and cried, but[XENO:n ]
they are now dating.

Seagal has decided to answer Rosa's declaration.[XENO:n ]
But Riko is always near so he can't do it himself.[XENO:n ]
He wants you to deliver a letter for him instead.
Talk to Rosa.
Return to Seagal.

Rosa has some misgivings but she has[XENO:n ]
accepted him and they are now dating.

Lecrough was going to accompany his friend to defeat[XENO:n ]
a monster, but was assigned to another mission.[XENO:n ]
Go and complete it for him.
Defeat 6 [System:Color name=item ]Eryth Hilns[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.
Return to Lecrough.

You completed the mission in Lecrough's place.[XENO:n ]
It seems their mission went well, too.

Zain and his friend need water that won't freeze on[XENO:n ]
their trip. But there is no waterfall nearby. Go to[XENO:n ]
the other waterfalls in the world and collect water.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Kasharpa Water[/System:Color] from Kasharpa Falls[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Statue Water[/System:Color] from near the Sororal[XENO:n ]
Statues in Satorl Marsh.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Makna Water[/System:Color] from Great Makna Falls[XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.
Return to Zain.

You collected water from waterfalls and gave it[XENO:n ]
to Zain. This will be enough for their trip.

Krall has lost a container of cream which is[XENO:n ]
necessary for travelling in cold climates.[XENO:n ]
He dropped it near an ether deposit at Eryth Sea.

Find the [System:Color name=item ]Chalk Container[/System:Color] on Anu Shore[XENO:n ]
at Eryth Sea.
Return to Krall.

You found the missing item at Eryth Sea and[XENO:n ]
returned it to Zain's friend, Krall.

Defeat Lakebed Orthlus at Colony 9 and obtain[XENO:n ]
Orthlus' Liver. It is sure to be invaluable to Zain[XENO:n ]
and Krall on their adventure.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Orthlus' Liver[/System:Color] on Agora Shore[XENO:n ]
in Colony 9.
Return to Zain.

You gave the Orthlus' Liver to Zain. Everything[XENO:n ]
is ready for the adventure now!

There has been no communication from the two who[XENO:n ]
went to the ruins on Valak Mountain. Perhaps there[XENO:n ]
was an accident? Go and find them quickly!

Find Zain near Three Sage Summit on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.

Find Krall near Three Sage Summit on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.
Return to Milia.

You found the two on the mountain, injured by[XENO:n ]
monsters, and brought them home safely.

Arietta's daughter has suddenly decided she hates[XENO:n ]
other races. Arietta wants you to find out why. Talk to[XENO:n ]
Louise and find out what happened.
Talk to Louise.
Collect 2 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Marine Marble[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.
Talk to Louise.
Return to Arietta.

You have found out why Louise hates other[XENO:n ]
races, and you told her mother.

The old Louise didn't used to worry about race.[XENO:n ]
Remind her of Vivian and get the two to be[XENO:n ]
friends again.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Morning Dew Ice[/System:Color] from Befalgar Pedestal[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain. (Only at dawn.)
Talk to Vivian.
Talk to Louise.
Return to Vivian.

Louise has remembered how things used to be[XENO:n ]
and she's now friends with Vivian.

Elior wants to learn about stars so he can become an[XENO:n ]
adventurer someday. He has asked you to find Milia,[XENO:n ]
one of the most passionate astronomers in the capital.
Talk to Milia.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Silver Eks Plates[/System:Color] from Stella Eks at[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea.
Talk to Milia.
Return to Elior.

The telescope that Milia made should help Elior[XENO:n ]
understand the night sky better.

Elior is looking for a smart Nopon to help him improve[XENO:n ]
Milia's telescope so he can see even more. Find a[XENO:n ]
clever Nopon to make his dream come true.
Talk to Galba.

Find an [System:Color name=item ]Attachment Part[/System:Color] in the Second Treasury[XENO:n ]
of the High Entia Tomb.
Give the Attachment Part to Galba.
Return to Elior.

The telescope is much improved. Elior can really[XENO:n ]
start to understand the stars even more now.

A guard is suffering from back pain as a result of[XENO:n ]
overexertion. Take care of a subjugation mission in[XENO:n ]
his place, to put his friend's mind at rest.
Defeat 6 [System:Color name=item ]Archer Hodes[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.
Return to Guarda.

You took care of the mission, and the guard has[XENO:n ]
promised not to push himself too hard in future.

Find some bugs for a hopeful youth. For a few hours[XENO:n ]
immediately after hatching, this bug will shine gold.
Collect 9 [System:Color name=item ]Gold Caterpillars[/System:Color] from Tephra Cave.
Return to Tet.

You got the bugs he asked for and delivered[XENO:n ]
them safely. He can enjoy observing them now.

Nero wants to go drinking with his friends but gets[XENO:n ]
drunk very easily. Get him the ingredients for some[XENO:n ]
medicine that will make him want to drink less.

Collect 2 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Feris Blood[/System:Color] from Feris[XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Pagul Hot Pots[/System:Color] from Cruz Paguls at[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea.
Return to Nero.

You collected the requested items for Nero.[XENO:n ]
Now he and his friends will have a great party!

Vol'aren's two children were playing outside, but now[XENO:n ]
his son is nowhere to be seen. He can't leave his[XENO:n ]
daughter's side, so find his son for him.
Find Atael.
Return to Vol'aren.

You found the lost child and returned him safely[XENO:n ]
to his father.

When Vol'aren had his back turned, his daughter went[XENO:n ]
missing. He can't leave his son unsupervised, so go[XENO:n ]
and find his daughter for him.
Find Kiino.
Return to Vol'aren.

You found the lost child and returned her safely[XENO:n ]
to her father.

Popie's son hates to be outside lately. Talk to him,[XENO:n ]
work out what the problem is and find a way of[XENO:n ]
getting him to enjoy the outdoors.
Talk to Balor.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Ether Roses[/System:Color] from Satorl Marsh.
Talk to Balor.
Return to Popie.

You solved Balor's problem and though not the[XENO:n ]
perfect solution, he's happy to be outside now.

You need to get a Secret Club Card so you can get in.[XENO:n ]
This is the perfect chance - they don't know you're on[XENO:n ]
to them yet! Quickly, find someone who has a card!
Find someone who has a Secret Club Card.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Rufus Control Units[/System:Color] from Orluga Rufus[XENO:n ]
in the High Entia Tomb.
Give the Rufus Control Devices to Nero.

You got the membership card to get into the[XENO:n ]
Secret Club! There is no time to lose!

The transporters are broken, trapping people in[XENO:n ]
Whitewing Palace. It's only a matter of time before the[XENO:n ]
Telethia come. Fix the Ether Furnace Controls.

Find someone who can use the Ether Furnace[XENO:n ]
Controls and ask how to fix them.

Fix the Ether Furnace Controls so that[XENO:n ]
the transporters will work.
Talk to Vivian in Whitewing Palace.

The transporters are working. You saved the[XENO:n ]
people trapped in the palace.

A resident wants help with her monster ecology[XENO:n ]
research.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Cruz Paguls[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You have completed the resident's request.[XENO:n ]
She will be able to continue her research.

A resident wants help with her monster ecology[XENO:n ]
research.
Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Eryth Ansels[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You have completed the resident's request.[XENO:n ]
She will be able to continue her research.

A resident wants help with her monster ecology[XENO:n ]
research.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Ciconia Ekidnos[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You have completed the resident's request.[XENO:n ]
She will be able to continue her research.

There are lots of monsters outside according to the[XENO:n ]
guard's family. It will take time for the guards to come.[XENO:n ]
Help out by clearing some.
Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Chloro Laias[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request.[XENO:n ]
You defeated the monsters that his family saw.

The monsters are coming from a different source. It[XENO:n ]
will take time for the guards to come. Help out by[XENO:n ]
clearing some.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Stella Eks[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request and[XENO:n ]
defeated the monsters he asked you to.

There is a monster that breeds very quickly. It will take[XENO:n ]
time for the guards to come. Help out by clearing[XENO:n ]
some.
Defeat 1 [System:Color name=item ]Racti Lexos[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request and[XENO:n ]
defeated the monster he asked you to.

You have been asked to defeat some monsters to[XENO:n ]
improve the security of Achamoth.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Unine Hodes[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You have completed the resident's request.[XENO:n ]
That is one less threat for Achamoth now.

You have been asked to defeat some monsters to[XENO:n ]
improve the security of Achamoth.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Tocos Orluga[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You have completed the resident's request.[XENO:n ]
That is one less threat for Achamoth now.

You have been asked to defeat a monster to[XENO:n ]
improve the security of Achamoth.
Defeat 1 [System:Color name=item ]Pelargos Ekidno[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You have completed the resident's request.[XENO:n ]
That is one less threat for Achamoth now.

There has been a request from the minister that[XENO:n ]
monsters on Soltnar Seal Island are defeated.
Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Somati Kromars[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request and[XENO:n ]
defeated the monsters he asked you to.

There has been a request from a guard that[XENO:n ]
monsters on Soltnar Seal Island are defeated.
Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Tussock Kromars[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request and[XENO:n ]
defeated the monsters he asked you to.

There has been a request from a guard that[XENO:n ]
monsters on Soltnar Seal Island are defeated.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Otol Kromars[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request and[XENO:n ]
defeated the monsters he asked you to.

Complete the mission of a resident's boyfriend[XENO:n ]
for him.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Proper Bandaz[/System:Color] in the area of Secluded[XENO:n ]
Island at Eryth Sea. (Only during shooting stars.)

You completed the Achamoth resident's request[XENO:n ]
and completed the quest for her boyfriend.

A group of workers has been attacked by an unknown[XENO:n ]
monster. It would be dangerous to let it go. Find it and[XENO:n ]
defeat it.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Tempestuous Edegia[/System:Color] on Hovering[XENO:n ]
Reef 10 at Eryth Sea. (Only at night.)

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The dangerous monster is dead.

A guard has been forced to take on a quest he will[XENO:n ]
never be able to complete. Help him out by[XENO:n ]
completing it for him.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Peeling Kircheis[/System:Color] on Hovering Reef 7 at[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request[XENO:n ]
and completed the quest for him.

When a resident was taking a walk, she saw a[XENO:n ]
terrifying monster. It should be killed before it[XENO:n ]
harms anyone.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Lightspeed Sonid[/System:Color] in the area of[XENO:n ]
Anu Shore at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request[XENO:n ]
and eliminated the danger.

A resident wants to make a present to thank his[XENO:n ]
co-workers for covering for him, but he doesn't have[XENO:n ]
enough materials. Collect what he needs.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Glossy Grady Fans[/System:Color] from Lunar Gradys[XENO:n ]
at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
He can make the present now.

A resident wants to make a costume. Help her[XENO:n ]
by collecting something exciting to start it off.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Orluga Grass Skirts[/System:Color] from Orluga in[XENO:n ]
Makna Forest.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
She will be able to make a great costume now.

A guard wants to make a doll for his child who he[XENO:n ]
doesn't see much. Unfortunately, he doesn't have[XENO:n ]
enough clothes material. Collect some for the guard.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Orluga Slacks[/System:Color] from Orlugas at Eryth[XENO:n ]
Sea.

You completed the Achamoth guard's request.[XENO:n ]
He can make the doll's uniform now.

A resident doesn't have enough materials to make[XENO:n ]
his favourite musical instrument. Collect the materials[XENO:n ]
for him.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Lexos Beards[/System:Color] from Racti Lexos at[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
He can make his instrument now.

The girl's stomach pains wouldn't be so bad if she[XENO:n ]
had some nutritious food. Collect some collection[XENO:n ]
items for her.
Collect 3 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Gold Burdock[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
She's all better now.

A resident's beloved pillow is worn out. Collect[XENO:n ]
some collectables for him.
Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]White Tails[/System:Color] at Eryth Sea.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request[XENO:n ]
and collected all the items he asked for.

A friend's mother is feeling down and a resident is[XENO:n ]
very worried. Collect some collectables for her.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Stardrops[/System:Color] in Achamoth.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Her friend's mother feels a little better now.

A resident has run out of materials necessary to repair[XENO:n ]
a flying machine and will be unable to complete his job[XENO:n ]
at this rate. Collect some collectables for him.
Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Spiral Lamps[/System:Color] in the High Entia Tomb.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The flying machine has been repaired.

While out walking, a resident dropped a keepsake[XENO:n ]
that his mother gave him. He's not sure where he[XENO:n ]
dropped it, but it was very important. Find it for him.

Find the [System:Color name=item ]Mother's Necklace[/System:Color] on the second level[XENO:n ]
of Achamoth.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
He's very happy to be reunited with the necklace.

A resident has lost the ring he planned to give to[XENO:n ]
his girlfriend. Find the very precious item for him.
Find a [System:Color name=item ]Silver Ring[/System:Color] somewhere in Achamoth.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
He is very happy to get the ring back.

A resident has dropped a gift that a merchant friend[XENO:n ]
gave him. Find the precious item and return it to him.

Find the [System:Color name=item ]Merchant's Gift[/System:Color] somewhere on the lower[XENO:n ]
level of Achamoth.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
He is very happy to get his gift back.

When the Nopon was moving house, he lost a very[XENO:n ]
special charm that could never be replaced. Find[XENO:n ]
it for the poor child.

Find the [System:Color name=item ]Health Amulet[/System:Color] on the lower level of[XENO:n ]
Achamoth.

You completed the Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The boy is very happy to have his charm back.
